name: AAIF Identity and Trust group, issue
status: Issue #13 of aaif/wg-identity-and-trust compares how MintID and Proofable record authority at the point where an agent action is dispatched; on 2026-10-09 it was open with 7 comments, and the shared runner proposed for it, issue #287 and pull request #288 of agentrust-io/integrations, were both open and had not been merged. TRACE, the format those integrations cite, is a specification with a released reference package (agentrust-trace 0.11.0, 2026-09-25) and a Developer Preview status. Reading of 2026-10-13: issue #13 is open with 8 comments, the last of 2026-10-09 (15:20 UTC), in which the Proofable author writes that the corrected package of 2026-10-08 "is frozen" at commit 9851059 of proofable/docs and "This supersedes the `63fc73b` update from 7 October." The same comment lists its limits: "Author-operated (SELF); no independent witness." and "Revocation latency is not measured and is not claimed." The SHA256SUMS file of the frozen packet (seven entries) was recomputed here on 2026-10-13 on the files as fetched from that commit and all seven match, and trace.jsonl has no carriage return; the earlier digest discrepancy is therefore not open for that packet, and the superseded package keeps its historical failure. Issue #287 is open with 3 comments. Pull request #288 is open and not merged, head 74fc43c with 19 commits; it was approved on 2026-10-12 by the project lead of TRACE, who also wrote that "treat the independence flag as the reporter's own claim, since nothing in the runner checks who executed the run", while the latest review state of the other reviewer was still the change request of 2026-10-07. The description of the pull request still says 27 tests; a comment of 2026-10-11 by the runner's submitter reports "all 34 tests pass without skips" after integrating a contributor's fork pull request that repins Proofable to the frozen packet (figures declared by the sources, at different heads; not reconciled and not re-run here). Messages of the group's list after message 48: not read (the archive requires JavaScript and its rules ask for a licence for automated AI access). The group's Reference Architecture sub-group has a working draft, "Agent Identity Primitives", Status "Draft", Version "0.1", dated 2026-08-27, in a Google Doc readable without a login (read 2026-10-13, open comments included). Its scope clause reads "The following are out of scope: authorization models (what an agent is permitted to do), evidence, reputation, and security controls or threat modeling." Section 3.5 says revocation "must propagate within a bounded time window"; a comment on it proposes that "implementations should declare the maximum time from revocation to first refusal by a relying party, and publish a reproducible measurement". Section 5 reads "Every agent action must be traceable through the delegation chain to a real-world principal that is accountable for it"; a comment proposes adding "A relying party must be able to verify that such a principal exists, at a stated assurance level, without necessarily learning who it is." Those proposals are comments in the document and are not in its text. Section 3.4 (Delegation) reads "This section is under active discussion." Commerce, merchant, seller and purchase: not found in the document text (2026-10-13).
relevance: The group's README says "This working group meets every Thursday, alternating between 6:30AM and 9:00AM USA Pacific Time." and points to a public mailing list on lists.aaif.io; the archive of that list was not read. Issue #13: MintID and Proofable each posted a row of the comparison (comments of 2026-10-04 and 2026-10-06); on 2026-10-07 a reader wrote "Proofable's trace.jsonl also has LF endings, and its SHA256SUMS and manifest hash a CRLF copy", and the Proofable author replied that the repaired record "hashes the exact published LF bytes". Proofable's public repository has a correcting commit, 63fc73b of 2026-10-07 03:33 UTC, whose message says "The prior manifest digests were computed over CRLF bytes while git stores LF."; the trace.jsonl and the SHA256SUMS line of that commit agree (SHA-256 computed here: b70a6b9d). A newer packet dated 2026-10-08 was published in commit 4ceb58b. MintID publishes tags on GitLab (gitlab.com/mintid/mintid): public-v2026-10-08.1 (2026-10-08 02:33 UTC, commit 19287bb5, "Published from source revision 1c57bc06a670.") and public-v2026-10-08.2 (07:57 UTC); the project has no release objects. The repository agentrust-io/integrations is described as "Ecosystem integrations for cMCP, TRACE, and Agent Manifest. Vendor-maintained, structure-validated, tiered."; its README defines two tiers, Community ("We do not run your code") and Verified, and says the tier "is set by maintainers, never self-declared". Issue #286 (pavancharak, 2026-10-06, open) proposes a refund scenario as a test package mapped to TRACE in three cases (valid approval, refusal, replay) and states "Mock results only."; the project lead answered that Parmana "keeps signing its own canonical form" and that a mock connector result "must never be referenced as `observed-effect`". Issue #287 (wlad232, 2026-10-07, open) says "This is a shared evidence-appraisal runner, not a comparative certification.", asks to "Preserve `not_applicable`, `not_emitted` and `not_measured`" and lists "Released TRACE 0.11.0 reference shape validation only". Pull request #288 reports "27 tests including valid control, forged dispatch, action tampering, duplicate suppression, deadline closure, manifest coverage and missing-case rejection" and "No Verified tier or conformance level is requested."; two reviews of 2026-10-07 (by a reviewer and by the project lead of TRACE) request changes, on enforcing the complete comparison contract and on the repository's lint gate, and the first review states "12 TRACE Reference shapes validated" (figures declared by the sources). TRACE (agentrust-io/trace-spec): "Developer Preview. Launched at Confidential Computing Summit, 23 June 2026. Spec v0.2 is current."; the specification text is under the Community Specification License 1.0 and the code under Apache 2.0; the Project Lead listed in MAINTAINERS.md is Imran Siddique (AgenTrust-io), with two spec editors from OPAQUE Systems and two repository maintainers. Messages of the group's public list archive (lists.aaif.io/g/wg-identity-trust), read by the author on 2026-10-09. Where a figure is also in the public pull request, that is the first source. Message 44 (Vlad, 2026-10-07 12:01 UTC) says "The recorded local validation has 27 passing tests and 12 validated TRACE Reference shapes." and that the submission "does not establish a completed matched comparison or a Verified tier"; the same figures are in pull request #288 and in its RESULTS.md. Message 45 (Vlad, 2026-10-08 07:13 UTC) says "The review fixes are now merged in our public source repository: all 14 contract fields receive explicit states, with not_applicable, not_emitted and not_measured kept distinct." and "28 tests, 12 reference-shape checks and the exact repository Ruff 0.16.9 gate pass", and adds "The GitHub PR branch has not yet been updated because this session cannot access GitHub"; the repository named is on an external Gitea host (git.elibot.ru, pull request 5 of agent-bot/aaif-publication-reference), cited and not opened. The count 28 differs from the 27 of pull request #288, which on 2026-10-09 still described 27. Message 46 (Marc, MintID, 2026-10-08 07:59 UTC) says the 503 "was the public testnet", that "From public-v2026-10-08.1 a 5xx is recorded as a service interruption, never as a decision, and the run completes", and "As you said, Vlad, a verifier's refusal is a decision, not evidence that a relying party enforces the veto."; the same explanation of the 503 is in the public comment 6055462962 of integrations#287. The tag public-v2026-10-08.2 of the public MintID repository exists and its folder test-harness/trace/records lists 22 files, among them records dated 20261008T050450Z and 20261008T053335Z (read on GitLab, nothing run). Message 47 (Hiroshi Yamakawa, ALIGN, 2026-10-08 09:14 UTC) says "We will pin public-v2026-10-08.1 or later", that Kazuya Saginawa (bitgrit) "runs the node and the trace", that "The emergency path needs operator credentials, so we will record it as not independently reproducible rather than omit it." and "We will confirm the start date on October 15." Message 40 (Marc, MintID, 2026-10-06) says "Imran, agreed on keeping not applicable, not emitted and not measured apart.", asks to "name the evidence each decision rested on (for us, the root's epoch and height), not only its age; that is what lets a reader tell a stale-evidence refusal from a revocation." and adds "Neither record is independently reproduced; both are operator evidence until someone else runs the trace." Message 48 (Vlad, 2026-10-08) says "We'll retain the earlier HTTP 503 attempt as historical evidence and record the new fixes and traces as operator-reported until independently reproduced", that "out_of_scope does not establish veto enforcement at a protected executor", and "Understood: October 15 is the checkpoint for confirming the start date." Proofable chronology (proofable/docs): commit 3a45f02, 2026-10-06 16:16 UTC, "docs(evidence): keep the public package evidence-only (no standards cross-link)"; its direct successor 63fc73b, 2026-10-07 03:33 UTC, "docs(evidence): publish the repaired authority-at-dispatch packet" (compare: ahead 1, behind 0); and 4ceb58b, 2026-10-08 16:38 UTC, "docs(evidence): publish the fixed authority-at-dispatch packet". The body of issue #287 and the reproduction posted by dinakarjs on 2026-10-08 (comment 6051738118) name 3a45f02, the commit before the repair. Message 45 (Vlad, 2026-10-08) also says "Proofable remains author-operated, sanitized evidence, with no independent target-side effect witness and unmeasured revocation latency; its known strict integrity FAIL is preserved."; on that date the runner of issue #287 and pull request #288 still names 3a45f02, the commit before the repair, as its Proofable pin.

committed_next.what: ALIGN to confirm the start date of its independent run ("We will confirm the start date on October 15."); a confirmation of the date, not the start.

evidence.read: On 2026-10-13: the state, comments, commits and reviews of issue #13, issue #287 and pull request #288, the Proofable comments of 2026-10-09, the frozen packet 9851059 (eight files, SHA256SUMS recomputed), and the Reference Architecture working draft in full.
